question: Nowadays, more and more women decide to have children later in their life. What are the reasons for this? Do the advantages of this outweigh disadvantages
essay:
In this day and age, women’s decision to postpone having children to later in their life have become more prevalent. There are several factors contributing to the rise of this social phenomenon. While acknowledging certain benefits that come with such case, I believe that the drawbacks outweigh them significantly.

To begin with, the most noticeable reason why women do not want children early in life is that our society is becoming more progressive. On the grounds that a lot of countries are pushing for gender equality in the workplace, women are encouraged to take on higher positions that not only promise them better career opportunities but also personal growth. As the result, women who find fulfillment and pride in their jobs will choose to delay childbirth, a duty that requires a lot of time and effort. In addition to this, more and more educated women choose to first reach an emotional maturity as well as a financial stability before having any children. On the virtue that raising children requires tremendous responsibilities, parents with little to no prior life experience will find it incredibly challenging, and in the worst case scenario, inexperienced parents can accidentally cause their children emotional and physical trauma. Moreover, child care can be burdensome for young women, which is why a lot of them choose to spend their younger days saving up to prepare for childbirth later in life.

Though our society is getting more progressive allowing women to have more freedom to have children later in life, this comes with significant negatives that could outweigh the positives. The most striking one is the growth of the aging population in some highly developed countries. For instance, Japan, with an alarming decline in birth rate in recent years, has experienced a shortage of a young and energetic workforce. As a result, it has to rely heavily on international talents. Moreover, with its senior residents on the rise, the country is also struggling with providing enough health care and social benefits that come from working people’s tax money. In addition to this, the lack of the youth can also lead to a weakening of national defense as it is comprised mostly of junior citizens. This could be exemplified in the case of Ukraine with a rapidly aging population, making it hard to have enough youngsters enlisting in the army to fight Russia.

In conclusion, two reasons for women delaying their childbirth are the progressiveness of our society and the emotional as well as financial maturity required to have children. Though there are several upsides to this social development, its disadvantages remain more prominent.
